settings.heading: Your size, right the first time.
settings.subheading: A few centimetres make a difference.

settings.heading: How to measure.
settings.note: Measure both feet and use the longer measurement.

settings.title: Place paper on a flat surface
settings.text: Place a sheet of paper on a flat surface.

settings.title: Trace your foot
settings.text: Stand on the paper and trace around your foot.

settings.title: Measure heel to longest toe
settings.text: Measure the distance in centimetres from your heel to the tip of your longest toe, then match it with the closest length in the size chart.

settings.title: Between sizes
settings.body: If you fall between sizes, go for the larger one for extra comfort.

settings.title: Buying for someone else
settings.body: Look inside a shoe he wears now: the EU size is usually printed on the tongue or under the insole. Choose the same size.

settings.title: If the size is not right
settings.body: All measurements are approximate and serve as a guide only. You can exchange a full price pair within 5 days of delivery, unworn and with the Supply Unit seal attached, as per our Exchange Policy. Sale pairs are final for size.

settings.heading: Need help?
settings.text: Message us on WhatsApp or call +92 319 9628735. We are happy to help.
